cases.title: Project launch decisions

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Hi, I'm Alex. Let's settle the launch work today.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Hi Alex, I'm Maya. Yes, let's go through it.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: We could add a dark mode to the dashboard.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Maybe, but let's leave that as an idea. We are not approving dark mode today.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: I'll send the wireframes by October sixth, twenty twenty-six.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Agreed. Please send those wireframes.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Actually, I need until October eighth, twenty twenty-six, for the wireframes. Can we change the deadline?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Yes, agreed. Use that later date instead of the original wireframe deadline.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I will write the launch announcement. Let's make that a task for me.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Agreed, Maya. Please write the launch announcement.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Wait, marketing is handling the announcement. Cancel my task to write it.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Agreed. That announcement task is cancelled.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: We also need to run an accessibility audit before release.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Agreed. The accessibility audit is a confirmed task, but we have not assigned anyone and have not agreed a deadline.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Which analytics provider should we use?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: We have not decided. That provider question is still open.

expected.reason: Explicitly left as an unapproved idea.
Self-assignment accepted, then the replacement deadline accepted. October 6 belongs only in history.
Accepted task explicitly cancelled later; marketing is context, not a newly accepted assignment.
Explicitly confirmed without owner or agreed deadline. Before release is the proposal, and the later reply explicitly says no deadline is agreed.

clarifications: Assign an owner to the accessibility audit.

cases.title: One controlled deadline change

replaceTurn.text: Actually, I need until October ninth, twenty twenty-six, for the wireframes. Can we change the deadline?

cases.reason: Only the final wireframe deadline and its evidence content change; timestamp shifts are immaterial. All other expected fields inherit A.

cases.title: Relative date and unassigned owner

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Hi, I'm Alex. Let's discuss the usability test.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I'm Maya. I think we should run the usability test by next Friday.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Agreed. The usability test is confirmed for next Friday. Could you own it?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I can't commit to owning it. We need to ask someone else, but nobody has accepted responsibility yet.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Understood. The test and deadline are agreed, but the owner is still unassigned.

expected.reason: Task and relative deadline are accepted. Maya explicitly declines ownership; no calendar anchor exists.

clarifications: Assign an owner to the usability test.
Clarify the calendar date intended by next Friday.

cases.reason: Digital silence contains no reliable speech. Request a new recording and return no invented commitments.
